title: 한글 최종 점검 1: 이 낱말, 어떻게 읽어요?
objective: Read words with linking, ㅂ→ㅁ, silent ㅎ, and ㅌ+이→치.
summary: Check that you can read four Hangul sound rules aloud.

task.title: Check your reading
task.line: Say each word out loud first, then choose or write its real sound.

letters.as: Linking: a final consonant moves into the next silent ㅇ.
Final ㅂ before ㄴ sounds like ㅁ.
Final ㅎ before a vowel is silent.
Final ㅌ before 이 sounds like 치, as in 'cheese'.

exercises: Choose the real sound: ① 단어: [단어] / [다너] ② 목요일: [모교일] / [목요일] ③ 옷이: [옫이] / [오시]
Write the real sound in [ ]: ① 입니다 ② 갑니다 ③ 옵니다
Is the sound in [ ] correct? Write Yes or No: ① 놓아요 [노아요] ② 좋은 [조흔] ③ 끝이 [끄티]
Which rule is it? Write linking, ㅂ→ㅁ, silent ㅎ, or ㅌ+이: ① 넣어요 ② 십니다 ③ 발음 ④ 붙이다
answers: ① Yes ② No ([조은]) ③ No ([끄치])
① silent ㅎ ([너어요]) ② ㅂ→ㅁ ([심니다]) ③ linking ([바름]) ④ ㅌ+이 ([부치다])
